Just a side note, this is an excellent beginner song for rhythm guitar. There's a few varied ways they played it, but they're the same chords. G C G C D C D C. The G C G C is the verses, switch at each line of lyrics, and the D C D C follows the same pattern. You can throw a hammer-on D7(?) in the chorus.

About 2/3 through, you get to 'Got two reasons why I cry, away each lonely night.'

For that, you still do the full G C G C D C D C except there is no chorus. Then you just follow the lyrics, that's the only 'tricky' part. It's pretty easy and good practice. You can do some fun fingerpicking variations and the chord changes aren't very fast. It's good for a beginner. Highly recommended.
